about: The quantity rules every new subject pack meets, per chapter. ONE list, read by tools/validate.py (skill make_pack.py, tools/build.py) and copied into engine/packcheck.js RULES (app, Gemini generator, connector); tests/pack_rules.js checks the two agree. tools/CONTENT_SPEC.md 'Quantity guide'.
notes: A value under 'features' is required when the subject has that feature (subject.features.code / .math) or, for 'pictures', when the chapter has a picture (a figure block or a picture exercise): pictures only where they teach (docs/VISUAL.md §5), never to meet a count. A chapter that uses an optional value anyway needs the minimum too.
subject.authoring.minPerKind overrides every 'min' (start_subject.py writes 3). 0 turns the rules off: only for packs made before 2026-10-21.
Chapters of an older pack being extended (skill unpack.py) get warnings, new chapters errors.
